format: C++/CX (Component Extensions for Runtime) header file
description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to calculator command snapshots within the CalculatorApp's ViewModel layer, including command representations, history items, and snapshot structures for the calculator's state.

classes.name: UnaryCommand
classes.description: Represents a unary operation command with a list of command identifiers.

classes.name: BinaryCommand
classes.description: Represents a binary operation command with a single command identifier.

classes.name: OperandCommand
classes.description: Represents an operand command with properties indicating negativity, decimal presence, scientific notation, and associated commands.

classes.name: Parentheses
classes.description: Represents a parentheses command with a specific command code.

classes.name: CalcManagerToken
classes.description: Token structure containing opcode name and command index.

classes.name: CalcManagerHistoryItem
classes.description: Represents a history item with tokens, commands, expression, and result.

classes.name: PrimaryDisplaySnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of the primary display value and error state.

classes.name: ExpressionDisplaySnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of expression tokens and commands for display.

classes.name: StandardCalculatorSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of the calculator's core state including history, display, and commands.

classes.name: ApplicationSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of the application mode and optional calculator snapshot.

methods.name: CreateExprCommand
methods.description: Creates an expression command object from a given expression command interface.

methods.name: ToUnderlying
methods.description: Converts a vector of expression commands or history items from Windows Runtime collections to underlying shared pointer representations.
